question: At the only first divergence among nine replayed ordinary paths, does the new scheduler actually confirm the provisional image model, complete selection and independently reproduce the final predictions?
eligibility: Run only the unique case previously identified by the recorded fit-free replay. Use the original unmodified training and prediction feature packets, all original candidate resources, mode feedback-confirm and the original limits. No candidate, decision or prefix is forced into solve.
endpoints: Compare the actions and training-fold scores up to the divergence, the first changed action, its actual confirmation score, final model and its fold evidence, number of physical fits, successful refit and independent prediction reload. Retain mismatches as results.
boundary: This is a selected, previously studied development case. Its external labels and earlier scored report are excluded from execution; external accuracy is not an endpoint. One path up to 11 classifier fits including refit, 600 seconds, zero language model requests.
